note: MYTHOS estate MCP registry — METADATA ONLY. Names every MCP server MYTHOS runs or consumes: purpose, direction, transport, authentication requirement, declared tools, enabled state, consumers. No value may appear here — a credential is named by its Vault reference (cred_…, see projects/mythos-vault/credential-inventory.json) and lib/mcp-registry.js refuses the file if a key that names a secret holds anything else, or if any secret-shaped string appears anywhere. Registration is a CLAIM: bin/mcp-registry-check measures availability and writes the snapshot OTHMODE reads. The runtime registries stay authoritative for their own direction — ContextForge for what the gateway serves, projects/mythos-ai-executor/config/mcp-capabilities.json for what a skill may name outbound. This file indexes both; it replaces neither.

oth-mcp.purpose: Controlled READ interface over existing MYTHOS capabilities: knowledge, project portfolio, capability registry, execution truth, budget position, estate health. Stores nothing; every tool resolves to the system that owns the data.

auth.note: reached over SSH as deploy or spawned by the bridge; the process holds no credential of its own — each upstream is reached with that upstream's own bearer

mythos-mcp-http.purpose: Streamable HTTP transport in front of oth-mcp so ContextForge can federate it. Declares no tool of its own; every answer is produced by oth-mcp and relayed unmodified.

auth.note: one bearer, held by ContextForge; a client without it is refused 401 before any relay

mythos-mcp-http.tools_note: relayed — the declared set is oth-mcp's

contextforge.purpose: MYTHOS MCP Gateway — one HTTPS door for remote clients: federation of the servers above, per-client authentication, runtime registry, metrics.
contextforge.owner: MYTHOS — projects/mythos-gateway (IBM ContextForge, image pinned by digest)

auth.note: AUTH_REQUIRED=true on every path. The executor presents cred_contextforge_executor_client (issued 2026-09-02 to the dedicated non-admin identity executor@mythosprod.xyz, scope tools.read+tools.execute, MCP-ECOSYSTEM-3); it is resolved by env var NAME from the daemon environment and never returned to a caller. ChatGPT/Claude client tokens remain unissued (owner decision).

contextforge.tools_note: federated — discovered from peers at check time
contextforge.note: public: true since 2026-09-02 ~06:36 UTC — nginx was restarted (not by the MCP-ECOSYSTEM-1 session) and applied the /gateway/ block already present in the vhost. Measured after: /gateway/health 200; /gateway/mcp, /docs, /version, /tools 401 without a credential; /gateway/admin 404. Zero client tokens exist, so nothing can be invoked from the internet until the owner issues one.

github-mcp-rw.purpose: The official GitHub MCP server, write-capable, reachable only from the gateway network. Carries no credential of its own: the caller's bearer is forwarded per request.

auth.note: cred_github_gateway is active in the Vault inventory (owner decision #1, 2026-09-02); the executor resolves it by env var NAME from its own environment and presents it per request. The container still holds nothing.

github-mcp-rw.tools_note: the 57 tools github-mcp-server v1.10.1 exposes with toolsets default,actions,git,code_security,labels,discussions and --exclude-tools delete_file (MCP-ECOSYSTEM-4) — measured on 2026-09-02 and declared so drift is reported; classified by registry/mcp-permissions.json (delete_* stays destructive/DENY by hard floor even if a future image exposes one again)
github-mcp-rw.enabled_note: ENABLED by the owner on 2026-09-02 (MCP-ECOSYSTEM-2b) after cred_github_gateway became active in the Vault inventory. Disabling it again is one flag here; the credential is revoked at GitHub, never by editing this file.

github-mcp-readonly.purpose: A second, read-only instance of the official GitHub MCP server on loopback, hand-started on 2026-08-24 outside any compose project.
github-mcp-readonly.owner: unknown — no source in the repository

auth.note: no credential in its environment; a caller must supply one per request

github-mcp-readonly.enabled_note: ORPHAN CANDIDATE — no consumer found in the repository, in any agent configuration, or in any deployment file. Retirement is an owner decision; it is registered so it stops being invisible.

context7.purpose: Context7 documentation MCP (mcp/context7 image) on loopback, hand-started on 2026-08-24 outside any compose project.
context7.owner: unknown — no source in the repository
context7.enabled_note: ORPHAN CANDIDATE — same finding as github-mcp-readonly.
context7.tools_note: discovered live 2026-09-01 and declared so the check can tell drift from the known set
